subject.title: fix: preserve Feishu post line breaks

question: Should maintainers require live Feishu/Lark proof on this clean branch before merging it, or switch to another sibling branch as the canonical fix for the linked Feishu newline bug?
rationale: The remaining blocker is proof sufficiency plus canonical branch selection, not a narrow code repair that ClawSweeper can safely perform automatically.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for prose, fenced code, raw tables, and near-limit fallback before this branch can merge.

options.title: Adopt the proof-positive sibling after refresh
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99394 as the canonical fix only after its conflicts are resolved and maintainers accept its broader behavior.

options.title: Accept the bounded fallback now
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept that near-limit messages keep original single newlines, but that should be an explicit message-delivery tradeoff decision.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to add redacted Feishu/Lark rendered-message proof for prose, fenced code, raw tables, and near-limit fallback before this branch can merge.
